description:
Metrics for up to 60 keywords in one call: monthly Google search volume (Google Ads' 12-month average via DataForSEO Labs, the source every AuditAE tool uses), the last 12 months, the trend, CPC, ad competition, keyword difficulty (0–100) and search intent. Trends compare calendar months: monthly = last month vs the one before; quarterly / yearly = the median of the last 3 months vs the 3 before / the same 3 a year earlier, so a one-month spike can't set the base. For new keyword ideas around a topic use keyword_research instead.

Billing: 10¢ per call (1–60 keywords). Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call again within 24h is free. On the no-account server, a caller without credit gets one data call a day free.

Inputs:
  keywords — 1–60 keywords.
  country — ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR); default US.

Returns { country, volume_source, keywords: [{keyword, search_volume, monthly_searches: [{month, volume}], data_through, trend_pct: {monthly, quarterly, yearly}, cpc_usd, competition, keyword_difficulty, intent}], not_found, not_found_detail, cached, charged_cents }. data_through = the newest month with data (can differ by keyword). not_found = no Google Ads volume in this country (too rare, too new, or counted under a close variant); a site can still get Search Console impressions for one.

Example: { keywords: ["crm software", "best crm for startups"], country: "US" }

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default US.

name: get_keyword_metrics
title: Search volume, CPC and difficulty for keywords
